about_the_game:
Mandate Order is a strategy game set in the Warring States period. Starting from barren lands, build strongholds integrating production, defense and military functions. Manage resources and the people's will, expand your territory, counter threats, and ultimately rise to prominence amidst the chaos.

1.Flexible City-Building & Strategic Layout

Construct your stronghold where ever you want, utilizing modular components to freely place production, housing, and defensive structures. Dynamic seasons and weather not only alter the visual landscape but also directly impact your economy and army movement.

2.Philosophies Shape Your Civilization

Adopt the tenets of Confucianism, Legalism, Mohism, Yin-Yang, and other classic schools of thought. Your chosen philosophy influences your buildings' effects, your citizens' behavior, and your military policies. Recruit unique Advisors who embody these philosophies. Their abilities and counsel will unlock diverse strategic options and present you with critical event choices.

3.Dynamic Tactical Warfare on a Grand Scale

Command armies in massive, epic-scale battles featuring thousands of units. AI opponents dynamically adapt their strategies and launch intelligent, multi-faceted assaults based on your civilization's development. Fortify your cities with Walls, Forts, and defensive structures, or take the offensive to clear enemy outposts, assimilate refugees, and secure vital resources.

4.High Replayability with Varied Events

Randomly generated maps, resource placement, enemies military camps, and natural events ensure every round has different experence. A deep progression system involving rituals, Advisor development, and technological research provides layered goals. Manage and optimize complex production chains and logistics networks, supported by a comprehensive empire overview interface to maintain control over your expanding domain.

5.Inspired by History, Enhanced by Imagination

Our team has drawn upon years of expertise to create a visually striking Warring States period world that blends historical inspiration with a distinctive artistic style. The gameplay uniquely combines city-building survival, tactical combat, and grand strategy management, aiming to deliver an authentic ancient military experience while empowering player creativity. We believe the best games are forged not in isolation, but through continuous dialogue with our community. We welcome and value your feedback.
